## Why visit

The deliberate keg exception on the central route, useful for experienced beer travellers who want access to a wide international range as well as British pub traditions. The specialist selection, bottle fridges and staff-led recommendations distinguish it from a generic craft-themed bar. It can fill a style gap after several bitters and porters, or provide a take-home purchase. Keep the visit optional within a cask-first trip, but it is close enough to the essential Dale Street pubs that adding a small tasting need not require another excursion.

## Beer

CAMRA explicitly reports no cask ale. The venue specialises in rotating craft keg and bottled/canned beer.
